source.title: TCPL Consolidated Financial Statements (IAR 2025-26) and Tata Steel Integrated Report & Annual Accounts 2025-26
source.author: Tata Consumer Products Ltd (auditor Deloitte Haskins & Sells LLP); Tata Steel Ltd (auditor Price Waterhouse & Co Chartered Accountants LLP)
source.capture_mode: curl (TCPL consolidated.pdf; tatasteel.com/media/25904/tatasteel-iar-2025-26.pdf, 34.6 MB, 582 PDF pages, found via the investors page for IAR 2025-26) + pdftotext -layout; printed page found by per-PDF-page footer
source.beginning_middle_end_evidence: TCPL: balance sheet, P&L, cash flow, notes read; Tata Steel: contents/ratios, MD&A, consolidated BS, P&L, CF, note 42 read. Tata Steel site returned 403 to the default curl agent and worked with a browser user agent; no aggregator used.
source.limitations: Tata Steel pages cited as printed (numeric for MD&A, F-prefixed for financial statements). Series EBITDA for Tata Steel is my construction from P&L lines and differs from the company figure, shown side by side. No price-based ratio used, so no market-data fetch needed.

lab.tolerance: 1e-9 relative on numbers; gauge/ticks via check_render (1px)
lab.axis_and_clipping: Gauge axis fixed 0-9x; cover above 9 clamps the bar, shows full value and an off-the-scale marker; negative cover draws zero-length bar with signed value in label. Flow bar axis fixed 0-120 (max EBIT+other income 111); shortfall drawn dashed.
